name: @w6w-apps/personio
description: Manage employees, absences and documents, and read custom reports, through Personio's HR platform API.

w6w.longDescription:
Personio is an HR and talent management platform for SMBs and mid-market companies. This app covers its Personnel Data API: reading and writing employee records (including the attribute schema a given credential is allowed to see), reading absence balances, listing and creating day-unit time-offs and reading hourly absence periods, uploading documents to an employee's profile, and reading the custom reports built in Personio's Reports Builder.

Authentication mints its own bearer token from a Client ID and Client Secret via a POST to Personio's /v1/auth endpoint — despite Personio's own naming this is NOT a standard OAuth2 client_credentials grant (no grant_type, no Basic-auth header, a JSON body instead), and the resulting token is stable for 24 hours rather than single-use. A live health check tracks Personio's own Statuspage, scoped to its 'Public API' component specifically; Personio publishes no rate-limit response headers on any endpoint, so quota headroom is a declared absence rather than a guess.

Out of scope for this pass: Attendances and Projects (the v1 endpoints are deprecated with no documented v2 replacement in Personio's own OpenAPI sources), and the Recruiting API (a separate static token, a required company-id header, and no safe read-only probe to test it with).
